        public void solve(int testNumber, FastScanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            while (true) {
                int n = in.nextInt();
                int D = in.nextInt();
                if (n == 0 && D == 0) {
                    break;

                // Use Euler's formula for planar graphs: V - E + F = 2

                int edges = 0;

                // For n circles, maximum edges = 2n (each circle can be split into arcs)

                // So edges = n + 2 * vertices/2 = n + vertices
                edges = n + vertices;

                int faces = edges - vertices + 1; // +1 because we want regions with positive area
                
                out.println(faces);

        public String next() {
